analysis.role: Owns setup/restart, tile spawning, movement, merging, scoring and win/loss. Supported changes: constructor startTiles and optional guaranteed-four spawning.
Board cells, bounds, insertion/removal, empty-cell discovery and serialization. Unchanged.
Tile identity, position/value and serialization. Unchanged.

verification.runtime: not run for this acquisition; CI adapter acceptance is separate, not a per-output execution receipt

runtime.scope: Pinned 2048 adapter: real keyboard move, board sum delta (merges conserve sum), restart. Controlled random draws .01/.95; no in-progress board persistence or human review.
